name: nu-ide-check-parse-gate
description: nu --ide-check always exits 0 — parse failures surface as JSON diagnostic lines with "severity":"Error" on stdout, so a parse-check tier must grep output, not exit code (fabro-bfe1, scripts/qualitygate.nu check-loop-assets). Bare 'source <file>' auto-invokes the script's def main; --ide-check is the side-effect-free alternative. Checked-in smoke pattern: const-relative source + fail helper + trailing exit 0 to dodge auto-invoked main (evidence-smoke.nu).

content: .fabro/scripts/ is the canonical home for loop scripts shared by more than one workflow (stage-journal.nu, dup-run-check.nu, prompt-lint.nu). workflow.toml [[run.hooks]] blocks and stage prompts reference the one shared copy; scripts/lint-nu.nu globs .fabro/scripts/*.nu so every shared script is parse-linted. Never re-duplicate a loop script per workflow (three byte-identical stage-journal copies existed before 2026-09-16).

content: sd sync commits STAGED changes plus .seeds — unstaged worktree edits do not ride along. Commit code changes explicitly BEFORE running sd sync: on 2026-09-16 a staged git-mv of stage-journal.nu went out via seeds-sync while the toml hook rewiring stayed unstaged, pushing an intermediate HEAD whose workflow.tomls referenced deleted hook paths. Sequence: edit -> git add/commit -> sd sync -> ml sync -> safe push.

name: friction-score-trigger
description: friction-score.nu: deterministic 0-1 line-health trigger; architect workflow gated on it (fabro-562a)

sd CLI JSON read-shape near-miss: 'sd show <id> --format json' wraps the issue object under a top-level 'issue' key ({command, issue, success}); reading .get('description') from the envelope silently yields empty and an update built on it OVERWRITES the whole seed body (2026-09-17: four evidence extensions wiped 5c45/9a42/b765/8275 bodies before the roundtrip check flagged it). Recovery: restore lines from 'git show HEAD:.seeds/issues.jsonl' by id and re-apply. Prevention: verify the read shape on ONE seed before batching body updates; assert the current description is non-empty before constructing the new one; roundtrip-compare after every write.
resolution: Bodies restored from git HEAD by id and evidence re-applied correctly (verified via sd show roundtrip + sd doctor); prevention rule added to the iterate skill's shell-safe-seed-bodies clause: single-seed read-shape verification before batch updates + non-empty assert.

content: Prompts that instruct agents to read files under fs_hide-bound loop-asset paths (e.g. .fabro/skills/**) must mandate shell reads (sed/cat), not read_file — the node fs_hide envelope hides those paths from file tools (seed fabro-d856, run 01M2VVFMSQXHK0E3SNV2GNTP43).

description: Nushell scripting pitfalls hit in anchor_check.nu (run 01M2W42WNZFGPHT96HPW8FBKRZ, fabro-7611): (1) 'str replace --regex ... ""' with an EMPTY replacement errors at runtime and, inside try/catch, silently degrades the helper to [] — use 'path dirname' or substring instead; (2) '[" | cmd y"]' list literal parses the pipeline INTO the list element producing garbage records downstream — always wrap in parens: '[( | cmd y)]'; (3) this nushell has no 'glob --directory' — use '--no-file' to keep dirs. Symptom to watch for: helper returns [] with no error surfaced; debug outside the try/catch.
resolution: All three fixed in anchor_check.nu in-run (path dirname, parenthesized join, glob --no-file); future nu helpers should follow these forms from the start.

name: stage-journal-inspects-coverage-lint
description: validate-workflows.nu carries a class-level stage-journal inspects-coverage lint (fabro-e907): workflows whose workflow.toml has the stage-journal hook must appear in some graph's inspects union; revisor inspects extended to architect,conductor,develop,merge-upstream (absorbs fabro-6ab7's conductor arm)

nu 0.115 gotchas hit while extending tracker-guard.nu (fabro-d9f7): (1) 'str replace' is now LITERAL by default — a regex like '\.jsonl$' silently no-ops without --regex; use 'path basename | path parse | get stem' for stem extraction instead. (2) 'filter {|...}' is deprecated since 0.105 (use 'where {|...}'). (3) 'path basename $f' as a command-with-arg is a parse error inside parens — pipe into it ('$f | path basename'). All three cost debug cycles in run 01M2WECF1835SYN194D0D3SCF4 despite nu --ide-check passing.
resolution: Fixed in tracker-guard.nu by using path parse and where; future nu scripts should follow the same idioms

description: Seed fabro-a1ef brief asked for rule (c) in implementer.md citing a raw run-id literal '(basis: run 01M2R8FHE6NQ14SGKXJ015JWPZ...)', but prompt-lint (fabro-41de rule 6) hard-errors on bare run-id/fabro-XXXX literals in workflow prompts — the literal inclusion made qualitygate red and bounced the run. Seed briefs that edit prompts must not quote provenance literals; the implementer must strip them to semantic framing. Fix in run 01M2X8458MDWMRVBRVEMDX9W4J: replaced the basis parenthetical with '(measured: a 1.2s no-rebuild rerun re-emitted the OLD failure text)'.
resolution: Stripped the run-id literal from implementer.md rule (c), keeping semantic measured-cost framing; planner briefs should never instruct literal provenance quotes in prompts.

description: Run 01M2Y59HMPN1RTB0NBDAXB1EBG implementer bounce: the prior pass appended new smoke assertions to .fabro/workflows/develop/scripts/closeout-smoke.nu AFTER the explicit 'exit 0' guard (dead code — never executed, so the smoke still printed ok while the assertions were unverified) and used a fabricated seed-id literal 'fabro-9abc' that the qualitygate prompt-lint deterministically rejects ('seed id does not resolve in the tracker'), turning the tester red. Rules: (1) in sourced-script smokes guarded by a trailing exit 0, new assertions must be inserted BEFORE the success print/exit — verify placement by confirming the new code sits above the print line; (2) any fabro-XXXX literal written into a loop-asset script must be an id that resolves via sd show at write time (or a non-seed-shaped placeholder) — prompt-lint greps scripts too, not just prompts.
resolution: Fixed in the same run: moved the residual-label + regression-guard assertions above the success print/exit 0 and swapped fabro-9abc for the resolving fabro-22fa; smoke green, prompt-lint green, tester unblocked.

description: GHCR bootstrap gap (seeds repo, 2026-09-26): the FIRST docker push of a new container package under a USER account always creates it PRIVATE; the mirtuell docker host cannot pull it (401 unauthorized at sandbox init, run 01M2ZP1NXGP6DZ1R35Q7XPK3HN, 325 ms deterministic fail). Changing visibility via REST PATCH /user/packages/container/<name> returns 404 even with write:packages — GitHub supports container visibility changes only in the web UI (Package settings -> Danger Zone). fabro-toolchain is public, seeds-toolchain had to follow. Bootstrap checklist: after the first 'just image-release' of a NEW toolchain image, flip the package to public in the UI once — verify with: gh api /user/packages/container/<pkg> --jq .visibility (expects public) — or the first automation fire dies at image.pull.
resolution: pending: one-time UI flip of seeds-toolchain to public by the user; recorded as bootstrap checklist item for every future toolchain package (mulch repo will hit this too)
